reviews.text: Very Attentive
Everyone at Royal York Animal Hospital are friendly, professional and make sure Riley is happy when he visits!

Absolutely kind and caring and educated attention to my pets.
Always a pleasure to deal with the Royal York Animal Hospital.
From the enthusiastic staff greeting at the door … to the Vet’s time and thorough effort spent with my dog  - who had an annual examination.
My doggie was a tad frightened; yet all went well and he calmed down …great service always !!
They did a great job thanks

I would give a review but I am taking my cue from  my 2 pups (5 and 4 years old) that go to Royal York. They  get so ridiculously excited the second they get into the parking lot and realize where they are!  If they love going to the vets you know it’s a good review and they are well taken care of.
Great first experience at the clinic. Everyone was super kind to me and my cat, answering all my questions and very thoughtful answers. Will be going back!
Beware cat owners:  They are too cheap to fill litterboxes with no more than half a cup of litter. Disgraceful.
Very pleased with my recent visit to Royal York Animal Hospital.  Quick, competant Vet Service  at a reasonable price.  Will go back.

My cat received excellent care. She was very nervous but everyone was so kind, gentle and patient with her. I was really impressed with how well everyone listened to my concerns and answered my questions. All options were carefully explored and explained and they even outlined costs ahead of time.
I called a couple of days later and they took time to answer more questions.
We have always been so impressed with and grateful to Royal York Animal Hospital!

Wonderful staff and very fair pricing.
I'll be moving my family pets over to their clinic.

I’ve been using the Royal York Animal Hospital for over 30 years. It’s close to where I live, the staff are friendly and informative and Dr Allen is just the best- caring, compassionate and so gentle with our pets.  Currently I went in with our senior cat for a wellness check. All was well, and I will return as needed. Love RYAH.

The staff here is always friendly, caring, and professional. They make sure my dog is comfortable and well taken care of at every appointment. Our doctor was thorough, knowledgeable, and took the time to answer all of my questions. I very much appreciate the excellent care and attention they provide. I always feel confident knowing my dog is in such good hands. Highly recommend!
Hello Clive, thank you for the 5 star rating!
Great first visit and we will for sure be back.  Thank you!
They were professional, kind & took care of our lovely dog Adele. We a really appreciate their assistance.

My dog was recently seen for an open anal gland. He was very well taken care of and the price was very reasonable. I called many places and no one would take us same day and I was very happy that Royal York animal hospital took us.

Staff is very knowledgeable, friendly and I would highly recommend their clinic.

I was so impressed with the prompt service I received! I was able to get a same-day appointment, and the vet was exceptionally kind and knowledgeable. They not only recommended the right treatment for my Dog, but they were also very mindful of my budget and offered cost-effective options. Good location too.
Great experience, very pet friendly and also human friendly
Great care for my dog.

My dog was having a pretty bad skin reaction. they were able to get me an appointment the next day.  They gave great service. Provided meds and shampoo to help. after 24 hours of meds and a bath he is so much better. provided us with a long term treatment if we need.
Thank you for the 5 start rating Alex!
Your positive feedback motivates us, Brett! We look forward to seeing you again soon.

My experience here for my cat’s annual checkup, few health concerns and vaccinations was smooth and lovely. The staff were very friendly, and our visit with Dr. Amanatchi was especially great. The appointment was informative, and he took the time to address my concerns about my cat’s teeth. My cat also seemed much more comfortable with the vet and wasn’t scared here, which made the experience even better. Overall, a very positive visit!

They were Great With Thor.
His reaction to the medication has been very positive and he is back to his old self again.
Thank you so much for what Royal York Animal Hospital has done for him and my Family. I hope to have Thor for as long i can have him for the 11yrs old Saint Bernard he is.
Thank You.
I highly recommend
Lily is always so careful and caring with dog. She does such a great job with his grooming. Gentle and always to my liking.

Great place. My usual vet didnt have any spaces and recommended i come to royal york animal hospital.  They took my cat same day within the hour. They were very thorough without trying to upsell me. Im very happy with the service here.

Royal York animal hospital was incredibly helpful in making an effort to see our cat in record time . They were incredibly accommodating and supportive of our situation and were able to help us with our cat . They are an amazing group of caring and helpful staff. Thanks to all your support.
Lisa and Joe

I trust RYAH with my pup's care and they take excellent care of her. She gets really anxious with vet visits but everyone there is welcoming, calm, patient, and understanding with her. Would recommend to anyone seeking trustworthy and reliable veterinary care.
Great, empathetic care.  Very prompt responses to all concerns.  A great clinic atmosphere.
Thank you for the 5 stars Michelle!
We had a great experience at RYAH on Friday.  We called for a last minute appointment and saw Dr Quadis who helped us out with our dog’s seasonal allergies. The entire team was so helpful.
im a new patient to this clinic and my experience was amazing. dr allen was very thorough and not to mention the pricing is very friendly. definitely making this my new vet!

I’m very happy with Royal York Vet! I bring both my young dog and old cat. The doctors are caring and dedicated.  The office works seamlessly with my other vet that I have far away.  Highly recommended!!!
It is always a pleasure to come to the Royal York clinic and to experience the attention and care all the staff and specially Dr. Allen give to our little Gioia!
Thank you for the 5 stars Neil!
The doctor was very kind and they treated me very well, Akira.

The animal clinic/ hospital is very good place,, the staff and doctors are very professional, knowledgeable and friendly
My dog find herself very conformational.
Thank you!
Wonderful staff, very friendly and knowledgeable!

Hello Doreen, I'm sorry to hear you felt our services were overpriced. I'm definitely open to discussing any concerns you have about your visit. I searched your name in our data base and the only client I can find by your name hasn't been here in well over a year. 

Please feel welcome to give me a call at the hospital so you can share your experience. Thank you!

Brittaney ~ Practice Manager
416.231.9293
Thank you for leaving us a rating Michael!

We had a wonderful experience at Royal York Animal Hospital with our beloved Toffee! From the moment we walked in, the entire team treated us with so much warmth, kindness, and genuine care. The veterinary staff provided prompt, thorough attention and made sure we felt completely comfortable and informed every step of the way. It’s clear how much everyone here truly loves animals. Thank you for taking such amazing care of Toffee—we left feeling so grateful and reassured!

My rescue dog has been a patient and a groom client at RYAH for 8 years. Everyone - vets, techs, staff, groomers - does an outstanding job of making us feel at home and safe, not easy with my dog. He is large and has issues with trust, separation anxiety and manners. I have always been happy with our treatment, care and grooming. Other groomers have had problems with us, but not here. My dog is now an older gent and did not get good care as  young dog before I adopted him, so I especially appreciate their sensible, preventive advice on vision, behavior, nutrition, weight, oral care, supplements and healthy aging. Top grades all around, great care. But Dr. Allen may be Buddy's favorite, he just can't help it. Highly recommended.
Great experience there as always!  Very friendly staff that take great care of my cat
First timer taking my dog to royal York animal hospital.. amazing staff 👏🏻 🙌🏻 👌🏻 and docker amazing service couldn't ask for anything  better thank you for your help

We had a great experience bringing our puppy Carben in for his first vaccines! The staff was so kind, gentle, and patient with him. He absolutely loved everyone, and they made his first visit a wonderful experience. Highly recommend!
Thank you for the 5 star rating Danya!!

I chose to go to Royal York Animal Hospital because they care about their patients and had Doctors available on the long weekend for appointments and for those who called in last minute.  Gioia likes this hospital.  She is a very active and anxious dog, and the staff love her. She doesn't cower in fear or hide behind us. She sniffs out every corner.

Dr. Qadir Qadis was great with Gioia and she was happy waving her tail the entire visit.  It was a really good exam. Dr Qadis checked G thoroughly and calmed down my fears. He provided measures on how to mitigate any symptoms.  I was able to get my prescription and leave knowing we got the care we needed.

I can't say enough about this clinic.The staff at the desk, the assistants and the Doctors are all exceptional.

Thank you.

I brought my 12 year old cat in for a wellness check as well as his nails clipped.  Everyone was very friendly and attentive.  The doctor came and listened closely to everything that concerned me.  The doctor called me the next day to discuss Jonnys blood test results.  He was very thorough and spent quite a bit of time explaining and answering my questions.  I have never had this much care from another vet.  Usually a receptionist grabs him and gives him back to me, gives me some expensive food that I didn't ask for.

This was a positive experience and the price was very fair.  I will be back with Jonny for his next annual check up.

I appreciate the warm and friendly staff. My cat and dog have both had excellent experiences here. Their hours make it easier to balance vet needs with my work schedule, and their home delivery for prescription pet food is extremely convenient. They are transparent and reasonable with their pricing. I trust the team completely with the health of my furry family members.

Very responsive
Very sensitive to my pet’s needs
I will always bring my cat here. The service and staff are exceptional!
Thank you for taking the time to give us a review Diane.
Thank you for the 5 star rating Veronica!
Staff were friendly and very knowledgeable! Felt confident going to them about my cat, Carl.

We were referred to Royal York Animal Hospital by our regular vet, and the care we received here was nothing short of exceptional. The Vet and the support staff were kind and patient with our otherwise anxious dog, that she even relaxed while there to drink water and accept treats. What we really liked was that they were upfront about any and all potential costs before performing a test so that we were fully aware of how much we would be spending at the end of it all.
Thank you for the 5 star rating Jim!
Have been taking my 7 year old Maltipoo here since she was a puppy and we have always had the best experiences with everyone that works here!

We took our cat in for swelling on his face.  They got us an appointment right away and the vet was clear and collaborative about the best treatment.  The cost for this last minute appointment was reasonable and our cat is feeling much better now.
The team is very kind and caring. They want the best for you and your new puppy and have great resources to help whether the puppy stage.
Team was very patient with my anxious dog. Always willing to help out with any extra paperwork that my pet insurance requires
We’ve been bringing our dog here for the last 7 years. They are the best!

Thank you to Dr. Allen and to Kimberley for the wonderful visit to RYAH for our cat Oscar’s check up. Dr. Allen provided a thorough, kind and professional examination. Thank you so much Dr.  Allen and it was so great to see you back in the office. Many thanks to Kimberley as well who valiantly performed Oscar’s nail trim so well, he barely flinched. We were very pleased with our recent visit!
Thank you for the 5 star rating Christine!

I had an excellent experience at this veterinary clinic from start to finish. The receptionist was incredibly friendly, kind, and welcoming, and even managed to get my cat in for an earlier appointment, which I really appreciated.

From the moment we arrived, every member of the staff made us feel welcome. The clinic itself was spotless, and the examination room was clean, comfortable, and inviting. I also appreciated that they had a calming diffuser in the exam room, which helped my cat stay relaxed throughout the entire visit.

The veterinarian, Dr. John Allan  was outstanding—extremely knowledgeable, warm, compassionate, and thorough. He took the time to answer my questions and made both my cat and me feel completely at ease. My cat remained calm for the entire appointment.

As a new client, I also received a discount, and I found their prices to be very reasonable without compromising on the quality of care. Although the clinic is a longer drive for me, it was absolutely worth it. I left feeling genuinely impressed by the level of professionalism, kindness, and value they provide.

I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for exceptional veterinary care. They’ve earned my trust, and I’m very happy to have found them.

Thank you for the 5 star rating! 

PS; your sweet kitten brought delight to all of us when you were in
Excellent care by caring professionals. Dr. Allen is very special and such a great vet and person.
Visit was on time - very informative and caring bet - honest about what was needed or not!

Marti went for her annual check up this week. I love RYAH, they have cared for our pups for 8 years. They are always so flexible and accommodating and provide exceptional care. Marti is extremely loving but oh so anxious and Dr. John was just wonderful with her as always ❤️
Great staff they got me in quickly, very friendly, my dog responded well to them all my questions were answered. I would definitely recommend

We had to make an emergency visit with our dog, and the Royal York Animal Hospital took us in immediately. From the moment we arrived, the entire team was compassionate, attentive, and incredibly professional. The veterinarian took the time to explain every aspect of our dog's condition and treatment plan in a clear, thorough, and reassuring way, which gave us great confidence during a stressful situation. Every staff member we interacted with was genuinely caring, kind, and exceptional. We are deeply grateful for the outstanding care our dog received and would highly recommend this clinic to anyone seeking knowledgeable, compassionate veterinary care.
Very friendly and very professional with all our questions and concerns.  For a frist time costumer we felt very welcome and very comfortable in the environment.  Very clean.
Very friendly staff and dr. Qadir is very helpful … the receptionist KELLY is very kind and professional i highly recommend!!

Very present and knowledgeable Doctor saw my baby. Offered more information than I got at 2 other locations.  Also said they could refer us to a specialist for a surgery if it would make us feel more comfortable. Thanks Royal York !!

We have been taking our pets to Royal.Aninal Hospital for 23 years. .
They are always so.welcoming and it is such a pleasure to see Dr Allen every year for our cats annual.exams.

We came in for my dog Piper’s annual check up and vaccinations. I made the appointment easily online. Dr Allen was very personable and cheerful. He gave me some good advice and was kind with his suggestions. The Dr was efficient and kind and I always feel we are good hands at Royal York Animal Hospital.
thank you for the 5 stars Sonia!
Treated my baby girl with love and care. Great service
Cats were better right away after we left! Thanks!
Thank you for the 5 star rating CJ! Your boys are delightful and we're happy to be here for you.
My absolute favourite clinic to bring my dogs to. The staff are always very reassuring, empathetic and always provide best care and treatments!
Such a lovely vet! Dr. Olivia was great, she took good care of our cat when she had urine crystals. I also love how they are open so late and have available parking.

Our experience at Royal York Animal Hospital was wonderful! This was our cat Benny’s first visit after our previous veterinarian retired, and we were hoping to find a new clinic where both of our family cats would receive exceptional care. From the moment we arrived, everyone on the team was so kind, welcoming, and gentle with Benny. A special thank you to Dr. Olivia, whose compassion, attention to detail, and thoroughness immediately put us at ease. She took the time to answer all of my questions, and it was clear how much she genuinely cares about her patients. Best of all, Benny was so calm and comfortable throughout his visit! (The free treat could have had something to do with it too haha) We left feeling so confident in our choice and are looking forward to bringing our other cat for her visit as well. Highly recommend!
My dog Nala has been a long time grooming client at RYAH. Both Lily and Karina are amazing! Nala always comes out smelling delicious and looking beautiful. Highly recommend 👌 …

We took our 9 week old puppy Pepper to Royal York Animal Hospital for a general check up and first vaccination. The staff was very warm, pleasant and welcoming to us and our initially nervous puppy. The veterinarian (Dr. Allen) was friendly, knowledgeable and answered all our questions and concerns. Pepper didn’t even notice when Dr. Allen vaccinated her. We will definitely be coming back!
Thank you for the 5 star rating Faith!

This animal hospital is truly exceptional. They are consistently quick with follow ups and make scheduling incredibly easy. Their hours of operation run from Monday through Sunday with availability well into the evening, which makes it simple to book appointments around a busy work schedule. The staff are friendly, attentive, and genuinely amazing, creating an experience that feels supportive from the moment you arrive.
We’re incredibly thankful for your outstanding 5-star feedback! It’s wonderful to know we met your expectations. Your support means everything to us, and we truly value your trust.
The staff at Royal York Animal Hospital are very kind and attentive.  I have been going to this clinic for 33 years and the care my pets receive has been wonderful!
Hello Angelina, thank you for the 5 star rating. We are delighted to have met your needs & expectations.
Thank you for the 5 stars Aleksandra!

You can be sure RY Animal Hospital will handle your fur baby with the utmost care.
Dr Allen is a very experienced vet and very gentle and caring.
Technicians are amazing as the front desk staff.
Always professional, clean and friendly. I love how informative the staff is. Have already recommend to several friends and will continue to do so.
thank you for the 5 stars Brendan. We appreciate your entrusting us with the care of your fur baby
Good job on nail clipping but I had booked an appointment for rabies booster as well and there was no vet available to give the shot. I now have to book another appt
Great care and service!
Great service all the time. Great staff. Have been using their services for 16 years, no complaints
I’ve taken my dog to  Royal York Animal hospital for over 10 years and all the doctors and the staff are very professional and compassionate. Great service and availability.
Thank you for the 5 stars Penka!
5 stars! Thank you Leanne.
Hello Richard, thank you for the 5 star rating!

As my dog is an anxious dog Royal York excels in accommodating him so well that our vet visit stress is now gone. The staff is very supportive and cooperative with him and make sure he is comfortable all the time which is a big Plus for us!!! ❤️

Great service, absolutely no judgement toward the breed of my dog which made me way more comfortable. They provided excellent care and services and even made sure we knew exactly what we’re getting and how much it is.
Awesome service to help out pup and ease our concerns

Everyone at Royal York Animal Hospital is so kind and our baby Chloe is so comfortable under their care.  She is treated like the true pretty little lady that she is.

Absolutely! You can post her photo on your social media considering everyone at your team helps to keep Chloe happy and healthy

Firstly, I just want to say how incredibly grateful I am to this clinic and the entire team for everything they’ve done for my cat, Yoshi.

A few days ago, I brought him in for an urgent visit after he had undergone major surgery elsewhere. Despite their busy schedule, they immediately made time to see him, assess his condition, prescribe medication, and most importantly, help calm a very worried pet parent. The past few days have been filled with stress, uncertainty, tears, and a lot of sleepless nights, but every member of the team treated both Yoshi and me with kindness, compassion, and genuine care.

What stands out most about this clinic is how much they truly understand the bond between people and their pets. They never make you feel like just another appointment. Whether it’s an urgent concern or a simple question, they’ve always taken the time to listen, provide guidance, and ensure that both you and your pet feel supported.

I also want to recognize the wonderful front desk team. Every interaction I’ve had has been met with patience, warmth, and accommodation, even during stressful situations. Their kindness makes a difficult experience so much easier to navigate.

A special thank you as well to Sharen and Dr. Qadis for their quick response, attentiveness, and genuine concern for Yoshi’s well-being. Their prompt action and support meant more than I can put into words.

If you’re looking for a veterinary clinic that truly cares about its patients and their families, I can wholeheartedly recommend this team. Your pets will be in excellent hands. ❤️

We have been going to have our pup groomed at our vet. They're always amazing. They make us feel welcomed each time and keep us updated on what our guy Ace needs. Grooming is quick. Which we LOVE. They have him for just over an hour, which makes it less stressful for him. Easy for us to bring him in and get him back home so we can move onto other things. Thanks royal York vet!
Kind staff and clean environment. Dr. Josh Allen was extremely helpful and provided plenty of useful insight

The staff are amazing! So caring and attentive. My dog does not like coming to the vet … he gets rather nervous and the staff do everything they can to make him feel comfortable and safe. Karina who is his regular groomer is a treasure! She is so gentle and caring. My pup always comes home happy after being with her. Thank you to the incredible staff at Royal York Animal! 💜

this used to be a good place. I believe they were taken over by a corporation, not too long ago, and I assume through no fault of the employees the quality of services deteriorated to the point that I would not take my pet here. I had two dogs that were seen at this practice for years, with reasonable care.  the service, care and quality has become nothing short of  atrocious   the lack of effort from the reception staff and the random assignment of doctors just makes this terrible place to bring your animals.
Thank you for the 5 starts Holly!
Always caring and knowledgeable.
I take Coda in regularly to get groomed at RYAH. They always do an excellent job with his grooming- very professional and reliable!

Amazing experience at Royal York Animal Hospital. The staff were all so kind, professional, and caring. Special thanks to Daniela for securing an appointment, and for her ongoing support and kindness throughout the process. I’m also very grateful to  Dr. John Allan for the excellent care and professionalism. The level of service and dedication received was truly outstanding! Highly recommend.
Great grooming job as usual. Lily does a great job with both of our pups.
As always the team is carrying and loving to my baby, actually 19 year old cat. To me he is my baby and everything ❤️
Great experience for a very nervous cat.  Dr Allan was excellent
This is a wonderful, caring and expert group of vets and techs and all staff.  They care about your pet and know they are family.  They explain everything and all options.  I trust them completely.
Thank you Nil!
Staff is very nice.
Professional, quick and efficient will be my go to from now on! Thank you :-)
Best animal hospital,  Dr. Allen and team are wonderful.  Thank you for taking such great care of our dog.
Thank you for the fabulous rating Kristin!
Great staff. Efficient service. Highly recommend.

Every single time the team here is so patient and understanding. Not only that, but the vet is very open about how much everything will cost, and actively suggests the most affordable options. I feel like my cats are always in really good, caring hands here.

Thank you Dr. Chris for helping my niece’s dog!   I am so thankful for your expertise and kindness.

It’s very hard being a parent to an old dog because you know every moment is fragile.   Having a doctor who helps extend your pets quality of life as well as longevity is a blessing.  The staff here are also supportive and kind.

We hope to be coming for many years!
I like the place  and  the  attention you guys give  to  all  customers  very important to us

My little guy has been coming here since I got him. Every staff member is extremely accommodating and patient. We never once walked out unsatisfied. Thank you guys for everything you do to keep my little guys happy and healthy!
Ian, 5 stars! Thank you!
Excellent experience for Sephie's annual checkup.  All of my questions were answered and the staff were all wonderful with her 😊 …
Thank you for the 5 star rating Stephen. We are honoured by your continued entrusting us with your fur family's care.
Great service!
Excellent service. Staff are friendly and professional.
I take my dog for grooming, wonderful friendly staff

I’ve been bringing my boy here for years and recently had to bring him in for a bite wound. The staff were so amazing, they got us in so quickly, were incredibly gentle and caring with him, cleaned the area perfectly, and made a stressful situation so much easier to handle. Highly recommend this vet❤️

My 9 year old cat recently suffered from severe constipation and he received effective treatment quickly and without an appointment.  He has been a patient at Royal York Animal Hospital since he was 5 months old.  It's a great place to take your cat as it's a cat friendly practice - there's a dedicated cats-only exam room and the practitioners all treat anxious kitties with gentleness and patience.
Lily does an amazing job with my very anxious dog !
Thank you for the 5 star rating Melissa!
Best animal hospital.  Staff and doctors are great.  My furry family member is in great care.
I’m very happy with the service provided at Royal York Animal Hospital. My dog, Chester, is a patient since he was a puppy and the team always take a good care of him.
Thank you for the 5 stars Shannon!
Excellent care for our Westie by Dr Allen

Royal York Animal Hospital has taken care of my pet cat for 16 years - from boarding to veterinary care. My cat is a character known to the team…forever appreciative of their care. Special shout out to Dr. John Allen. He knows his way around cats with attitude!

We’ve been bringing our furry baby to Royal York Animal Hospital for over 10 years . She has always been taken care of in a loving manner and the staff has always been kind and concerned enough to follow up with us after a procedure or if Gigi has not been feeling well .
We are happy to continue bringing her to Royal York Animal Hospital for many many more years to come .
Thank you !

Dr Chris is the reason I changed to this vet.  She is extremely knowledgeable and truly has the pets wellbeing at top of mind. She is great to bounce ideas off of and she is always trying to find option for me with patches!  The outstanding assistance Gabriela and Kim Karina is the only groomer that can handle patches and he doesn’t look stupid after his cut! The very pleasant and calming lady at the front desk who can put your mind and ease with her voice! I can tell you all how much you have warmed my heart and put my mind at rest when I come with patches:) We don’t always take time to thank and appreciate people for a job well done so I wanted to ensure they get the recognition they deserve.

My dog has been a client of Royal York Animal Hospital for over 5 years. All of the staff are wonderful, especially with the way they treat all their clients (including the humans!). They are consistent with follow up after a visit and their grooming team (Karina in particular!) is excellent.

One of our senior dogs had an appointment yesterday at RYAH with Dr. Allen. We’ve been taking our dogs to RYAH for more than 25 years and the care is excellent! Dr. Allen is so knowledgeable and compassionate, and remembers every detail about our beloved pets. The care that Dr. Allen provides is exceptional and he works with superb veterinary technicians. They are a great team - highly professional, very responsible and committed to providing the best possible care. We are so grateful to Dr. Allen and the RYAH team!
My dog is always happy to come here. Even for a blood test…lol. The staff is caring and patient and kind and informative. Great vet clinc. 👍🏼😊 …
Been taking my cat here for years! Really convenient to be able to text to schedule and confirm appointments. Staff are all friendly -- even with my very poorly behaved senior cat.
Groomer is fantastic
The vets take the time to listen to your concerns. The staff is always friendly and helpful. Highly reccomend royal york animal hospital!
Thank you Carolina

I went here on a Sunday of the long weekend with an emergency. The team at Royal York Animal Hospital were very kind and patient, and my sick dog warmed up to each staff member immediately because they took the time to greet her and let her get comfortable, speaking kindly to her and cuddling her until she felt safe. And they explained everything to me along the way, giving me options without any sales pressure. I appreciated their "bed side" manner, their knowledge and care, and the follow up after the appointment too. It's evident that they truly care about the pets in their care. Thank you!

We have had consistently great experiences with this RYAH. The team is compassionate, patient, and takes the time to explain everything clearly so you feel confident in your pet’s care. You can tell they genuinely care, not just about the animals, but about the owners too. It’s never rushed, and we always feel heard. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a vet they can trust.
Dr. Allen is an amazing veterinarian. So tentative and caring with our multipoo.

The BEST vet! My dog is a special needs rescue pup who needs a team, and RYAH provides just that. I’ve been going for years and I’ve always felt that my dogs needs are heard and taken care of. I also take my special needs cat here, and they are so good tnat I wouldn’t even take a second opinion. Love this vet so so much!
I have been coming here for a few years and the service is always prompt, and they always follow up to check on your pet. Dr. Alan is great.

Had a wonderful visit with Gertie Jayne and Dr Chris.
Her knowledge and professionalism and ability to connect are exceptional.
Always appreciate the caring RYAH Team !!
I have been coming now to RYAH for over 30 years and will continue given their exceptional care and access 7 days a week .
Thanks to you all.

My guy Bentley, a rescue who is skittish around folks, is so comfortable with the folks at Royal York Veterinary.
The most time he spends there is when he goes for his semi annual grooming (all his curlies buzzed off).
Karina is one of the most talented folks I have ever met. She transforms Bentley from a scruffy mutt to such a refined gentleman. I leave everything in her hands and defer to her judgement as to what the outcome should look like.
What is such added value is that she gives a post grooming report of his behavior and any issues that I should look into such as his upset stomach and a bump on one of his paws that needs to be monitored. I really appreciate her insight.
Not only that but she, and the rest of the staff, greet all the patients/ clients with such enthusiasm that makes the pet feel so welcome.
I look forward to Bentley’s next appointment!
Thank you Kathy.
Our last visit for Bella went really well. Reception staff is welcoming and friendly and the Vet doctor listened and made appropriate recommendations for our situation and they always follow up

I’ve been bringing my corgi, Taika, to RYAH since she joined our family. Over the years, their customer service has consistently improved, with thoughtful follow-ups after appointments and attentive care tailored to our feisty girl.

At her most recent annual visit, I was especially impressed by the vet techs and Dr. Debora. Thank you for the continued dedication—keep up the great work!

Just took our cat Marley in for his annual appt and the team there were so attentive and genuinely caring, making sure Marley felt comfortable the whole time. It's such a relief to know he's in such capable hands. We are so happy with our experience!
A 5-star review is the highest praise. Thank you for your glowing recommendation!
Thank you Kim for taking the time to post a review. 🤗 …
Dr Qadis has been helpful, patient and insightful as I navigate my aging cat’s health.
Very grateful for the care our cat Ashley received from this hospital. The vet was very thorough and helpful.  Thank you.
Thanks for the fantastic rating, Raman! We strive to make every visit a 5-star experience.
Thank you for the 5 stars! We strive to provide excellent service and are glad you had a positive experience.
Roxie is always in good hands. And knows exactly where the treats are! Lily does such a nice job grooming Roxie.

We had a really good experience this week!  Our pup, Patches, has had an ear infection in both ears for quite a while. We aren’t the best at doing the washes and the drops. Especially because he doesn’t like it!  We admitted it.  Everyone there was really kind about it. They just went ahead with swabbing. Well, his test came back that he was almost ALL cured!  Then they reminded us to keep at it for another 4-5 days— remember: He is a much happier doggie!  Thank you!
